SELECT 
    ds.date,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) as daily_revenue,
    SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as daily_cogs,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as daily_gross_profit

SELECT 
    ds.sku,
    p.name,
    p.pack,
    SUM(ds.units_sold) as total_units,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) as total_revenue,
    SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as total_cogs,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as gross_profit,
    (SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr)) / NULLIF(SUM(ds.revenue_inr), 0) * 100 as gross_margin_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.date) as days_sold,
    AVG(ds.units_sold)::numeric(10,2) as avg_daily_units
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY ds.sku, p.name, p.pack
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC;

SELECT 
    ds.date,
    ds.sku,
    ds.units_sold,
    ds.revenue_inr,
    ds.revenue_inr / NULLIF(ds.units_sold, 0) as avg_price,
    p.price_inr as list_price,
    p.cost_inr
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY ds.date;

SELECT 
    pl.sku_scanned,
    pl.unit_price,
    COUNT(*) as occurrences
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY pl.sku_scanned, pl.unit_price
ORDER BY pl.sku_scanned, pl.unit_price;

SELECT 
    pl.sku_scanned,
    pl.unit_price,
    COUNT(*) as occurrences,
    MIN(pl.bill_ts) as first_seen,
    MAX(pl.bill_ts) as last_seen
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
GROUP BY pl.sku_scanned, pl.unit_price
ORDER BY pl.unit_price;

SELECT 
    pl.sku_scanned,
    pl.unit_price,
    COUNT(*) as occurrences,
    MIN(pl.bill_ts) as first_seen,
    MAX(pl.bill_ts) as last_seen
FROM store.pos_lines pl
GROUP BY pl.sku_scanned, pl.unit_price
ORDER BY pl.sku_scanned, pl.unit_price;

WITH failed_upi AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_ref as bill_id

    AND status IN ('failed', 'returned')
),
bill_payments AS (
  SELECT bill_id,
         COUNT(*) as attempts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN tender = 'upi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as had_upi,
         MAX(CASE WHEN tender != 'upi' AND till_status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_other,
         MAX(CASE WHEN tender = 'upi' AND till_status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as upi_paid
  FROM payments.pos_payments

    AND bill_id IN (SELECT bill_id FROM failed_upi)

)

    CASE WHEN s.units_sold > 0 THEN ABS(f.forecast_units_per_day - s.units_sold) / s.units_sold ELSE NULL END AS ape
